title: What different engineers do
examples: What kind of things do mechanical engineers work on?
Can you explain what a software engineer actually codes?
Do biomedical engineers work with living things?

explain.say: A civil engineer designs large structures you see every day. They build things like bridges and roads for us.
Mechanical engineers focus on machines and how they move. Think about engines or even simple toys.
Electrical engineers design and work with electricity. They build things like power grids and phones.
Chemical engineers use chemistry to make useful products. They help create things like medicines and plastics.
Software engineers write the instructions, or code, for computer programs. They make apps and websites work.
Biomedical engineers mix biology and engineering. They help design things for the human body.

faq.q: Do engineers just build big things like bridges?
faq.a: No, they build many different things using science. They also design small electronics and software too.
asks: What is the scope of engineering?
Do they only work on construction?

faq.q: Which engineer works on computers and phones?
faq.a: Software engineers write the code for those devices. Electrical engineers handle the power and circuits inside them.
It is more about designing tools and artificial parts for the body. They might design a better artificial joint.
asks: What is the focus of bio-engineering?

faq.q: What is the difference between civil and mechanical?
faq.a: Civil engineers build large structures like buildings. Mechanical engineers focus on the moving parts inside machines.
asks: Which one builds the car engine?

faq.q: Do all engineers need to know chemistry?
faq.a: Some, like chemical engineers, need deep chemistry knowledge. Others focus more on physics or computer science.
asks: Is chemistry needed for all engineering?

facts: Civil engineers design structures for people to use.
Mechanical engineers study motion and energy transfer.
Electrical engineers deal with the flow of electric current.
Software engineers write instructions for computers to follow.

quiz.say: A person designing a new type of artificial heart valve is most likely a:
quiz.why: This involves combining biological knowledge with engineering design.

wrong.0: Electrical engineers focus on power and circuits, not body parts.
wrong.2: Civil engineers focus on large structures like bridges and roads.
wrong.3: Mechanical engineers focus on moving parts and engines.

quiz.say: If you were designing the wiring for a new school's lighting system, you would need an:
quiz.why: This job deals directly with the safe flow of electrical power.

wrong.0: Civil engineers build the building structure, not the internal wiring.
wrong.1: Software engineers write code, they do not handle physical wiring.
wrong.2: Chemical engineers work with substances, not electrical currents.

quiz.say: Which field involves creating new medicines or improving materials through chemical reactions?
quiz.why: Chemical engineers use chemical principles to create useful substances.

wrong.1: Mechanical engineers focus on how things move, not chemical reactions.
wrong.2: Software engineers work with digital instructions, not chemical formulas.
wrong.3: While related, biomedical focuses more on the body itself.
